usedFor: Calendly is where people book, and Google Sheets is the schedule you track. “New Meeting Book or Invitee Created” in Calendly can add a row through “Add New Row to Sheet” in Google Sheets.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting Book or Invitee Created” in Calendly, then “Add New Row to Sheet” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Calendly pushes each booking as it is made, giving one row per meeting without the duplicates the polling trigger can produce.

watchOut: “Invitee Canceled” can feed “Delete Rows”, which removes rows by range or number. Check that the row it removes is the booking that was canceled, as there is no undo.
